about_the_game:
"Make Money Playing Hockey!"
Add shooting elements to the intuitive feel of air hockey! Every time you smack the puck, coins jingle into your stash; when the match ends, spend what you earned to power up your paddle! With neon × pixel retro-future flair, jump into white-hot, spark-flying matches again and again.

Playtime

About 1 hour. Perfect for a quick pick-up-and-play session!

Streaming

Totally welcome! Upload/stream as you like. (The dev might pop in to watch!)

How It Plays

  • Match: Fast rallies—put pucks and projectiles into play and just keep shooting!

  • Results: Shows your money earned and the match’s heat level. You’ll get a 5-tier rating—aim for the top!

  • Upgrades: Spend your coins to power up your paddle for the next match.

Upgrades

  • Unlock Stage Cap: Raise the upper stage limit by +1 (requires clearing the previous stage).

  • Coins Gained +1: Earn an extra coin per pickup (MAX +4).

  • Base Defense +20%: Increases effective defense when hit (MAX +100%).

  • Base Attack +20%: Raises base damage dealt (MAX +100%).

Modes

  • Solo Play: CPU with 4 tiers (Lv1–3, ???).

  • Two Players: Local versus on a single keyboard.

Options

  • Skip Start Sequence for faster retries.

Post-Clear Bonus
There might be a little surprise...?

Controls

    Solo Play

  • Left: CPU

    Right: ↑/↓ Move, Shift Dash, P Shoot (hold to charge)

    Two Players

  • Right: ↑/↓ Move, Shift Dash, P Shoot (hold to charge)
    Keyboard only for now.

Disclaimer & Usage Policy

  • Coins in this game are in-game currency only and have no relation to real-world money or crypto assets.

  • The creator assumes no responsibility for any loss, damage, or impairment arising from the use of this game.

  • Unauthorized redistribution or commercial use is prohibited.

  • Uploading gameplay videos and sharing derivative works are allowed within reasonable bounds; no prior approval or report is required.

short_description: Neon-lit arcade action where Air Hockey × Shooter collide!? Unleash charge shots to take down your opponent! Play Solo (stage-clear) or 2-Player Versus. Rack up coins with every hit to upgrade your paddle and push into new stages. Fast, snappy matches that beg for “one more round”!
